name: Talmai
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Judah goes down against the Canaanites in the mountain, the south, and the valley, and against Hebron, which before was called Kirjath-arba, slaying Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

note.label: Judges 1: Judah Goes Up First, but the Inhabitants Are Not Driven Out
